**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 18-19 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 19

---

**19:1** When Levi had said this, they began to go forth to proclaim and to preach.

---

**The Gospel according to Mary.**

---

*Translator's Note (LOGOS):* The gospel concludes. In the 19-chapter schema, this final chapter bears only the departure verse and the title colophon. The text is complete.
